span.p:
Step-by-step:
1. Entry "G" arrives
2. Cache is full
3. Policy scans frequency buckets from lowest
to highest
4. Finds frequency-1 bucket with entries D, E,
F
5. Evicts "D" (or uses LRU tiebreaker within
bucket)
6. "G" is inserted in frequency-1 bucket with
count=1
7. When "G" is accessed again, it moves to
frequency-2 bucket

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Limitation: A entry with freq=10 accumulated
over days
stays in cache forever, even if access pattern
changes.
